definition: the feeling when your expectations are not met
description: Two men on a wooden jetty on a still lake at dusk. A bearded man in a bucket hat fights a deeply bent fishing rod, winding the reel hard, sure he has a big fish. His friend sprints up the jetty with a landing net ready. What breaks the surface and swings up onto the planks is a green rubber boot full of water and weed. Both men stop dead and stare at it, the friend lowering the useless net.

taps.phrase: to struggle with a fishing rod
